changes: Normalized paksa to 'śukla (śudi)' and weekday to 'Thursday (gurau)'.
Jīvanātha's affiliation now reads 'Baliāsa (Maithil mūla)'. The 'saṃ' after it is taken as the Panjī-style marker for a mūla-grāma, not as part of the name.
Notes now explain that the catalogue's 'King: Donor Jīvanāthopādhyāya' field is garbled. The colophon names no king and no donor.
Added a note that the 'san-' prefix in 'sanmiśra' is honorific sat-.
Owner role kept: it is inferred from 'pāṭhārthaṃ likhitam' (written for his reading).

purpose: for the reading (pāṭhārtham) of Jīvanātha Upādhyāya
notes: 'baliāsasaṃ' is read as the Maithil mūla Baliāsa (Baliyāsa) plus the Panjī-style 'saṃ' marker. The catalogue field 'King: Donor Jīvanāthopādhyāya' is garbled. The colophon names no king, and Jīvanātha appears only as the person the copy was written for to read, not as a donor. The place name Korau..grāma has a lacuna and cannot be identified. The 'san-' in 'sanmiśra' is honorific sat-. The owner role for Jīvanātha is inferred from pāṭhārtham. LS 472 + 1119 gives about 1591 CE.
